title: reportbot's jobs fail: 'No such file or directory'
description_md:
Automation that runs jobs as the `reportbot` service account (`su - reportbot -c '...'`) started failing with `su: failed to execute /usr/local/sbin/corp-shell: No such file or directory`. The account's configured login shell used to be a custom, audited wrapper binary that apparently isn't there anymore. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), find out what's actually going on, and get `reportbot` able to run jobs again.

You're done when `su - reportbot -c 'echo ok'` runs successfully.
